# Inverse

> Inverse covers entertainment, gaming, tech, and science through reviews, interviews, and analysis of films, TV shows, and emerging technologies.

Inverse is a digital media publication focused on pop culture, sci-fi, and technology. The site features in-depth reviews, anniversary retrospectives, trailer analysis, and exclusive interviews with creators across film, television, gaming, and consumer tech.

## Key Topics

- Science Fiction
- Movie Reviews
- Film Anniversary
- Trailer Analysis
- Doctor Who
- Netflix
- Marvel
- Streaming Recommendations
- Celebrity Interviews
- Gaming
- Pop Culture
- Cult Classics
- TV Shows
- AI & Technology
- Entertainment News

## Film Reviews & Analysis

- ['Ready Or Not 2: Here I Come' Review: The Rare Sequel That Improves Upon The First](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/ready-not-2-here-i-come-review-sxsw-2026): Review of Ready or Not 2 sequel with Samara Weaving directed by Bettinelli-Olpin.
- [The Most Surprising Action Thriller Of The Year Is Saved By Bob Odenkirk](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/normal-review-bob-odenkirk-action-thriller): Review of action thriller Normal starring Bob Odenkirk directed by Ben Wheatley.
- [29 Years Later, Guillermo del Toro's "Lost" Film Just Got An Incredible Upgrade](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/mimic-4k-3-disc-set-review-guillermo-del-toro): Review of restored 4K edition of Guillermo del Toro's Mimic.
- [How The Year's Most Surprising AI Thriller Crafts A Dangerously Beautiful Dystopia](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/dreamquil-alex-prager-interview-sci-fi-thriller-sxsw): Interview with director Alex Prager on AI thriller DreamQuil at SXSW.

## Sci-Fi Film & TV Anniversary Retrospectives

- [57 Years Later, The 'Dune 3' Trailer Changes The Books In Two Massive Ways](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/dune-3-trailer-book-changes-trilogy): Analysis of Dune: Part Three trailer and its divergence from Frank Herbert's books.
- [10 Years Later, One Underrated Sci-Fi Movie Shines A Light on The Genre's Corny Flaw](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/midnight-special-anniversary-10-years): Anniversary analysis of Jeff Nichols' Midnight Special and sci-fi tropes.
- [50 Years Ago, An Enigmatic Sci-Fi Film Prompted a Rock Star's Reinvention](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/the-man-who-fell-to-earth-50-year-anniversary): Anniversary retrospective on Nicolas Roeg's The Man Who Fell to Earth with David Bowie.
- [10 Years Ago, One Conflicted Sci-Fi Reboot Dropped A Wild Finale](https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/v-finale-10-years-anniversary): Anniversary retrospective on the V reboot's series finale.
